answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the lotus forfeiture reveals up in the ember totals with the dawn audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 162 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Retiring an identity early forfeits 41% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
